description: Returns one verse, or a range of up to 5, in full: the original and English text; word-by-word Strong's number, lemma and parsing where the words line up with the tagging; and the verse's cross-references, quotations between books, curated parallels, similar wording, questions it asks or answers, songs, scribal marks, Ketiv/Qere, Targum connections and, where the Hebrew says the LORD’s word came to a prophet, that recipient and the other places it came to them. Use when the user wants a thorough look at one verse, or up to five.

edition.description: which text, e.g. septuagint, onkelos, pseudo-jonathan, jonathan, hebrew-nt, hebrew or greek

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_verse_study
title: Study a verse
